title: Implement stereo cross feedback matrix in feedback controller
description:
Add the stereo cross-feedback matrix to Source/DSP/FeedbackController.h and Source/DSP/FeedbackController.cpp. Do not touch RoutingEngine, DelayVoice, or PluginProcessor.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/FeedbackController.h and .cpp (existing T60-derived gain computation and smoothing members)
- Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h (routing surface completed by task f.1; read only)
- Source/DSP/DelayVoice.h (how the feedback tap is consumed; read only)

Required behavior, restated so no external document is needed:
- Cross-feedback with parameter q in [0,1]:
  feedback_L = g * ((1 - q) * z_L + q * z_R)
  feedback_R = g * (q * z_L + (1 - q) * z_R)
  where z_L and z_R are the current left/right loop taps and g is the feedback gain.
- q = 0 is independent channels, q = 0.5 is stereo average, q = 1 is ping-pong channel exchange.
- The matrix eigenvalues are g and g*(1 - 2q), so the existing hard ceiling on g bounds stability across the entire q range. Do not add a separate q-dependent gain reduction.
- Feedback gain remains T60-derived: g = 10^(-3*T/T60) where T is the current delay time in seconds and T60 is the target decay time in seconds. The hard cap is unconditional: g_final = min(g_requested, 0.985), applied including during Hold.
- q is smoothed with a linear juce::SmoothedValue over 30 ms (normalized expert control). T60/feedback target smoothing stays at 50 ms. Filter frequency and T60 use multiplicative smoothing only where already established; do not convert existing multiplicative smoothing to linear.

Real-time rules that are binding: no heap allocation, locks, IO, string construction, buffer resizing, or unbounded loops inside the per-sample or per-block feedback computation. Any state needed for the matrix must be allocated in the existing prepare path.

Add a setCrossFeedback(float q) style setter and a process entry point that takes z_L and z_R and yields feedback_L and feedback_R, keeping the existing single-channel path working for mono layouts.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/FeedbackController.h declares a cross-feedback setter taking q and a stereo feedback computation entry point returning left and right feedback values
Source/DSP/FeedbackController.cpp implements feedback_L = g*((1-q)*z_L + q*z_R) and feedback_R = g*(q*z_L + (1-q)*z_R)
Source/DSP/FeedbackController.cpp computes g = 10^(-3*T/T60) and applies the unconditional cap g_final = min(g_requested, 0.985)
Source/DSP/FeedbackController.cpp smooths q with a linear juce::SmoothedValue configured for 30 ms
Source/DSP/FeedbackController.cpp contains no q-dependent gain reduction beyond the 0.985 cap
The feedback computation contains no new/delete, no malloc, no buffer resize, no juce::String construction, and no lock acquisition
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: raise, remove, or conditionally bypass the 0.985 feedback ceiling
allocate memory, lock, or construct strings inside the feedback computation

allowed: choose the exact signature style for the stereo feedback entry point
choose internal member names for the smoothed q value
forbidden: introduce a matrix or linear-algebra library
change the T60 to gain mapping
add extra stability compensation beyond the specified cap
alter the RoutingEngine or DelayVoice public interfaces
